residual_findings.detail: Export guard is complete || diagnostic. Final diagnostic exit checks omit first_bad_h and predicate failure counters. An immature/value/nonfinal/coinbase-bound failure alone can export and exit 0 in diagnostic mode.

Admitted script tasks omit height/position; script failure sets only first_bad_msg, not first_bad_h. Diagnostic export can therefore include a failing block and descendants, contrary to valid-prefix wording; later nonzero exit does not prevent the artifact.

complete is only a conjunction of first_bad_h, unresolved source specs, script failures and excluded transactions. It ignores missing or duplicate heights, skipped context/time/sequence checks, and absent complete starting UTXOs. Required coverage labels are comments, not JSON fields. Conversely absent source hints still block complete even if the join resolves them from local creations.

window_join checks cumulative output totals but not each output value, and does not call check_transaction. A 10000-satoshi input and outputs 12000,-3000 keep both running sums and final fee in range while containing a negative output. Header-free check_transaction is already available.
